headline: Jubo Dal leader hacked to death in Narayanganj
summary: Fakir Zahir Rahman, a local Jubo Dal leader, was attacked by unidentified assailants while returning home from his pharmacy. He succumbed to his injuries at a Munshiganj hospital.
details: Fakir Zahir Rahman, a Jubo Dal leader, was hacked to death by unidentified assailants in Narayanganj's Sonargaon upazila on Wednesday night. He was attacked around 10:00 PM in the Char Kishoreganj area while returning home from his pharmacy.

Rahman, 40, was a joint convener of Araihazar upazila Jubo Dal and president of its Kalapaharia union unit. He ran a pharmacy in Char Kishoreganj but resided in a rented house in Munshiganj Sadar upazila.
He died while receiving treatment at a hospital in Munshiganj. Police are currently investigating the incident, but no case has been filed yet.

He died while receiving treatment at a hospital in Munshiganj. Police are currently investigating the incident, but no case has been filed yet.

headline_marked: [[Mob kills paralysed man]] at Dhaka hospital over child kidnapping suspicion
headline: Mob kills paralysed man at Dhaka hospital over child kidnapping suspicion
summary: Alam Sheikh, 41, who was paralysed after a stroke, was beaten to death by a mob at a Dhaka hospital. He was seeking food and shelter when he was falsely accused of child kidnapping.
details: Alam Sheikh, 41, a paralysed man, was beaten to death by a mob at Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital in Dhaka on Wednesday night. The mob suspected him of being a "child kidnapper."

Sheikh, who had worked at a garment factory for nearly 20 years, became paralysed on his right side after a stroke two years ago. This forced him to leave his job, and he had been struggling financially, moving to Dhaka from Natore in search of work.
According to his family, Sheikh had gone to the hospital around 11:00 PM, looking for food and shelter. Relatives of children admitted there grew suspicious of him and began questioning him.

Dissatisfied with his incoherent answers, they dragged him downstairs and severely beat him. A hospital employee witnessed the incident, stating that Sheikh was speaking unclearly and at one point claimed his wife was admitted but couldn't provide clear details.

His elder brother, Yusuf Ali, and cousin, Habibur Rahman, expressed shock and denied any criminal record or intent to kidnap. They highlighted that Alam had three children of his own and was simply trying to rebuild his life.

Police recovered Sheikh's body from the hospital and sent it for an autopsy after an inquest. One person has been detained in connection with the incident, and the body was later handed over to the family following legal procedures.
Family members stated that Alam sometimes went hungry and sought help from others but had never stolen anything. They emphasized his physical and mental unwellness since the stroke.
